head_commit.message:
fix(tui): keep pending requests until resolution succeeds

Prepare app-server request resolutions without consuming their pending
entries, and only commit the removal after `resolve_server_request`
returns successfully.

This preserves retryable exec approvals when the resolution RPC fails,
so replay and consume-time stale-request guards do not hide prompts that
still need user action.

server, send requests, and await events
- refresh exec-server dependencies, configs, and documentation to
reflect the new flow

workflow_runs.display_title: fix(tui): support legacy app-server approvals

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): drop stale exec approvals at consume time

Drop stale `CommandExecutionRequestApproval` events when they reach the
active or replayed thread consumer and no longer have a matching pending
approval entry.

This avoids re-showing resolved legacy approval prompts from delayed queue
sends without introducing broader queue-cancellation state for a
deprecated compatibility path.
